title: Runner Config
description:
Configuration for a single ``runner.py`` invocation.

Cross-field invariants enforced by validators:

* ``attacker_model`` is meaningful only when ``workflow == 'redteam'``.
* ``exploit`` requires ``synthetic_vuln_id``.
* ``redteam`` (two-phase) requires exactly one of ``task`` (zero-day)
  or ``synthetic_vuln_id`` (synthetic).
* ``probe_only`` requires ``workflow == 'redteam'``, forbids ``task``
  and ``synthetic_vuln_id``, requires ``attacker_model``, and is
  incompatible with ``gold_run``.
* ``dry_run`` and ``gold_run`` are mutually exclusive.
* ``apk_obfuscation == 'on'`` requires ``no_codebase == true`` and
  cannot be used with ``build_type == 'source'``.

See ``documentation/EXPERIMENTS.md`` for the prose walkthrough.

build_type.description: How to acquire the APK: build from source, download a published artifact, or assume it is already in apps/<app>/apk/.
build_type.title: Build Type

no_codebase.description: When true, the agent receives only the APK at /app/apk/. When false (default), full source is mounted at /app/codebase.
no_codebase.title: No Codebase

apk_obfuscation.description: Research-instrument toggle selecting which pre-published APK variant to acquire: 'off' (default, un-minified release build, matches historical baselines) or 'on' (R8-minified release build, approximating production obfuscation). 'on' is only valid when no_codebase is true and build_type is download-apk or skip-apk. For download-apk, the selected app must publish download_link_obfuscated; for skip-apk, the obfuscated APK must already exist under apps/<app>/apk/obfuscated/.
apk_obfuscation.title: Apk Obfuscation

model.description: Model id (e.g. gpt-5.5, claude-opus-4-7, gemini-3.1-pro-preview). Custom path: routed via agent/custom/model_providers/factory.py. External path: forwarded to the in-container CLI.
model.title: Model

agent_image.description: Docker image the agent runs from. Custom path: kali base (e.g. cybench/mobilecybench:latest). External path: BYO reference image (e.g. cybench/mobilecybench:codex_0.130.0-r2, :claudecode_2.1.140-r2, or a lab's own tag).
agent_image.title: Agent Image

agent_mode.description: Dispatch path. 'custom' (default): in-process Python loop. 'external': BYO Docker image satisfying the contract in documentation/BRING_YOUR_OWN_AGENT.md (covers codex, claude-code, and lab-supplied agents).
agent_mode.title: Agent Mode

max_iterations.description: Maximum agent turns before stopping. Custom path only.
max_iterations.title: Max Iterations

max_model_response_tokens.description: Per-call output token cap forwarded to the provider.
max_model_response_tokens.title: Max Model Response Tokens

additional_system_prompt.description: Free-form text appended to the workflow-built system prompt (after any per-app additional_info from metadata.json). Applies to all agent modes.
additional_system_prompt.title: Additional System Prompt

reasoning_effort.description: Opaque reasoning effort / variant string forwarded verbatim to the selected provider or external agent image. Provider/CLI owns value validation.
reasoning_effort.title: Reasoning Effort

allow_unregistered_models_in_custom_mode.description: Permit models that are not declared in agent/custom/model_providers/factory.py:SupportedModel when agent_mode='custom'. Custom mode then falls through to LiteLLM with auto-detected routing and a runtime WARNING. External mode is BYO-owned and does not use this custom-mode registry; the external image owns model validation. Models without a row in utils/token_pricing.json report cost_source='derived_unpriced' unless the agent reports cost.
allow_unregistered_models_in_custom_mode.title: Allow Unregistered Models in Custom Mode

workflow.description: Pipeline to run. 'exploit' requires synthetic_vuln_id; two-phase 'redteam' requires exactly one of task (zero-day) or synthetic_vuln_id (synthetic); 'redteam' with probe_only=true forbids both.
workflow.title: Workflow

attacker_model.description: Two-phase redteam: dev/debug hint only — runtime reads the authoritative value from the task bundle's metadata.json and logs any override. probe_only: required and authoritative — there is no task metadata.json to read from. See documentation/REDTEAM.md.
attacker_model.title: Attacker Model

synthetic_vuln_id.description: Names a directory under apps/<app>/synthetic_vulnerabilities/. Required for workflow='exploit'; one of {this, task} required for two-phase redteam; forbidden when probe_only=true.
synthetic_vuln_id.title: Synthetic Vuln Id

task.description: Zero-day task selector for two-phase redteam. Names a directory under zerodays/reports/<app>/. Forbidden when probe_only=true.
task.title: Task

probe_only.description: redteam-only bundle-less mode: single replay against the app's baseline APK, no patch / no verifier / no two-phase comparison. Score is signal/no_signal based on app probes. Forbids task and synthetic_vuln_id; requires attacker_model. Incompatible with gold_run. See documentation/REDTEAM.md#probe-only-mode.
probe_only.title: Probe Only

dry_run.description: If true, launches an interactive Kali shell instead of the agent. Useful for verifying setup without API credits.
dry_run.title: Dry Run

gold_run.description: Replay the task's reference exploit through the full pipeline instead of invoking the agent. Mutually exclusive with dry_run.
gold_run.title: Gold Run

emulator_backend.description: Run the emulator as a host process ('native') or as a separate Docker container ('container', used by GKE).
emulator_backend.title: Emulator Backend

emulator_display.description: Whether the emulator opens a window.
emulator_display.title: Emulator Display

emulator_boot_timeout_seconds.description: How long to wait for the emulator to be ready (seconds).
emulator_boot_timeout_seconds.title: Emulator Boot Timeout Seconds

network_mode.description: Squid egress policy. 'permissive' (default): any public host. 'restricted': exact-FQDN allowlist (LLM APIs + apt/pip mirrors). Kernel routing (agent_net internal:true) applies in both.
network_mode.title: Network Mode

script_timeout.description: Seconds for long-running scripts (exploit, verify, setup, prepare_app).
script_timeout.title: Script Timeout

build_command_timeout.description: Seconds for the APK build command.
build_command_timeout.title: Build Command Timeout

apk_timeout.description: HARD wall-clock deadline (seconds) for the malicious-APK replay to write done.marker; agent cannot extend by withholding it.
apk_timeout.title: Apk Timeout

llm_request_timeout_ms.description: Per-LLM-API-call timeout (milliseconds). Used by the custom agent for provider calls and for docker exec calls into the kali container.
llm_request_timeout_ms.title: Llm Request Timeout Ms

agent_wallclock_seconds.description: Wall-clock budget for agent execution. External agents are terminated by the harness on expiry. Custom agents honor this limit when the field is explicitly set by the run configuration, stopping before the next turn with max_iterations remaining as a safety ceiling.
agent_wallclock_seconds.title: Agent Wallclock Seconds
